hidden_items.why: H8b fires. The edge classes `a / b` and `a %% b` can reach in the probe's declared input domain are: zero divisor (documented -- deterministic runtime error, L427), division overflow (documented -- L427), and the ROUNDING DIRECTION / REMAINDER SIGN for a negative dividend, which the canonical_task expressly places in the domain ('where `a` may be negative') and which the pinned reference does not document at all. No local token selects it: `/` and `%%` are the only integer division and remainder forms Quidra has, and there is no truncating/flooring/Euclidean variant to choose between. The universal-scope exclusion ('the reference fixes exactly one documented outcome across every type the form admits in this probe') cannot be discharged by route 1 of methodology 04 sec 1.4.0, because the reference states nothing about this edge class; a reader must run the compiler to learn that -7 / 2 is -3. LED therefore fails at condition 4 of sec 1.3. Single-assignment: H1-H7 do not claim this event, so it is assigned to H8 and counted once for the probe.

Rung ladder, recorded as the canonical_task requires: (i) a standard CHECKED operation yielding an optional/error value -- NOT AVAILABLE. Quidra exposes no checked-arithmetic method; verified `int32 a; a.checked_div(b)` -> error[UNKNOWN_MEMBER] "Type 'int32' has no method 'checked_div'", and language.md's arithmetic section (L421-L427) plus numeric-and-bytes document only `+ - * / %`, with `Type.parse` the sole numeric `T | error` facility and expressly 'distinct from a cast'. (ii) a standard WRAPPING operation -- NOT AVAILABLE; llm-guide rule 21 'Never use a cast to request wrap or clamp', and methodology 00 C-1 already records that a 64-bit wrapping multiply raises runtime error[INTEGER_OVERFLOW] rather than wrapping. (iii) a standard SATURATING operation -- NOT AVAILABLE, same evidence. (iv) the plain operator -- USED. Sub-requirement (1) is delivered: `int32 m = 2147483647`; Quidra exposes NO standard named maximum (verified `int32.max` -> error[UNKNOWN_NAME] "Unknown name 'int32'"), and the sub-requirement's own conditional 'if one exists' therefore admits the literal.
